verdict.rationale: The docs show a credit-based pricing model: Marlin is a pay-per-use tier on monthly Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans, add-on credits cost ¥98 each (¥85 discounted), cancelled runs still consume credits, and a single run lasts up to about eight hours. A researcher can grasp the billing structure before committing, but not the actual cost of a run or each plan's limits. Missing for 10: base plan prices, credits consumed per research run, credits included per plan, explicit usage caps or quotas per tier, and independent corroboration of pricing.
